title: Tender Data API – EU European Tenders, TED Europa, CPV Codes
description: Search the EU's official TED public-procurement journal by country, CPV code, date or open submission deadline. Returns clean, deduplicated JSON in your choice of 24 EU languages: buyer, value, deadlines, CPV codes and notice link. Includes tender notices, contract awards and corrigenda.
seoTitle: Tender Monitoring, Tender Tracking, Bids and Tenders
seoDescription: An EU government tenders API: procurement notices api, ted tenders api, eu tenders api, eu procurement api, procurement alerts, tender alerts, tender data feed, and public procurement notices exports.

result.eventDescription: One normalized procurement notice returned to the dataset.
